profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at TDS Telecommunications LLC
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary: Experienced in Java, Python, and Javascript in the fields of Software Engineering and Frontend Development.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Hired to automate and refine models for portfolio reallocation, arbitrage, and technical analysis-based trading. Using Node.js to develop an Electron based-frontend to create a friendly, intuitive, and easy-to-use GUI for the desktop application. Began transitioning code base from Ruby to Golang.

positions.title: Informational Technology Intern
positions.description: Had the opportunity to experience working in an industrial environment as an informational technology intern at General Dynamics Electric Boat (EB), the primary builder of submarines for the US Navy, located in Groton, CT.   As an intern, built and oversaw a database of employee assets as part of a continuous improvement initiative by the IT team (i.e. to ensure that everyone at the company was using the most up to date software and hardware). Involved in automating the asset management process to identify any assets needing attention, with the ultimate goal of minimizing work overhead. Developed a UI that allowed users to quickly locate assets in need of updates while also alerting owners of assets nearing expiration.

positions.title: Summer Research Intern
positions.description: Undergraduate bioinformatics research project in Dr. Jason Kwan’s lab at the University of Wisconsin-Madison in the summer of 2016 offered me another opportunity to tackle interesting and challenging problems, in this case with biomedical relevance. The Kwan lab uses shotgun genome sequencing of DNA isolated directly from environmental samples (i.e., “metagenomics”), to discover antibiotics and anticancer molecules encoded in the genomes of bacteria that cannot be grown in laboratory settings. This work was sufficiently impactful to be the focus of conference talks and posters that were presented at the 2016 Joint Natural Products Conference in Copenhagen, Denmark, and a manuscript that was recently submitted for peer review.
